title: Eaton Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q1 2026 net sales were USD 7.451 billion, diluted EPS was USD 2.22, operating cash flow was USD 507 million, and total debt was USD 21.129 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed Q1 report remains Eaton's latest financial filing pending the scheduled July 31 Q2 release; it supports the maintained demand thesis and acquisition-leverage risk.
